caption:
When most people think about losing muscle, they think about getting smaller or weaker.

But muscle affects much more than what you can lift in the gym.

As we age, maintaining muscle helps us maintain our ability to do life.

It's what helps you:

• Get out of a chair
• Climb stairs
• Carry groceries or luggage
• Work in the yard
• Get down on the floor—and back up

Muscle supports strength, balance, stability, physical capacity, and metabolic health.

When the workout feels good.
When life is easy.

Weight regain after dieting is one of the most stigmatized experiences in health. The science says it has nothing to do with discipline.

The human brain evolved to protect body fat during times of food scarcity.
